title: g2-car-fairing: deviation-bounded fairing of G2 B-spline car-body surfaces (code and data)
description: Code and raw results for the study 'Integral fairness is not enough: deviation-bounded fairing of G2 B-spline car-body surfaces in a smooth reduced design space'. Includes four bicubic B-spline car-body test surfaces, the curvature-variation objective and local-degradation measure, thin-plate, L-BFGS-B, jDE, PSO and GWO optimisers, 2196 optimisation runs and the statistical analysis.
